display.summary: ScanLink connection fixes: automatic workstation HTTPS setup and clearer browser connection guidance.
highlights: ScanLink 0.7.5 provisions and renews its trusted localhost certificate automatically on Windows; no certificate commands or imports are required.
The ScanLink panel checks both loopback transports, bounds connection checks and follows first-run setup progress.
Scanning reports insecure application addresses separately from connection failures, with English and Arabic guidance.
Includes the document OCR features and deployment requirements from DjangoLux 1.15.
